name: Resul Aydoğan
bio: Resul Aydoğan was born on January 18, 1992. The gaming adventure that started on that day has always been his passion. After completing his bachelor’s degree at the Faculty of Physical Education of Kütahya Dumlupınar University, he completed his master’s degree in Leisure Games. He founded the Educational Games Academy in 2016 and became chairman of the board of Funly Eğitim Teknoloji ve Oyun Ticaret A.Ş. in 2023. He has designed hundreds of games and educational materials and revealed the magical power of games in education. He wrote the “Handbook of the Chosen One” series for children. He continues to design games with his cute and playful friend Bella and share these games with children.
